title: Coordinate adjunction category interfaces
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite field extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its valuation ring [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a field $k$. For the ordinary strict varying-coefficient towers and uniform constructible finite-Tor full subcategories of [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers], [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian] and [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers], and the fixed operations of [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels], [lem-sp-tower-chart-admissibility], [det-sp-tower-p1-adjunction], [lem-sp-coefficient-tower-shriek-calculus], [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], define the following coordinate interfaces: restriction of a specified functor pair to two full subcategories with an actual Mathlib adjunction, its ambient Hom bijection, unit and counit; finite evaluation of this pair with both unit and counit and both transpose compatibility equations on the entire finite constructible categories; and the realized compact-support and right-functor coordinate comparisons. For the ordered scheme tower of [def-amb-affine-trace-tower], define separated finite-type bases over k, the normalized P1 presentation and its Hom bijection, the actual open Hom bijection, the iterated ordered right functor, its coordinate bases, and the actual etale restricted adjunction. These are data interfaces and real functor constructions; no existence of a coordinate adjunction is asserted.
